design.decision: Bid high, then play for runs: each consecutive win is worth the size of the contract, so both the bid and the order of play matter.
design.opponent: Revealed on the first consecutive win; opponents interrupt runs and defend hard against the big contract.
design.rationale: Combines the two strongest common shapes (cb-consecutive-mult and cb-contract-mult) under one condition, scaled by the contract for bid tension; it keeps one trigger and one effect, and the scaling uses the existing per-contract-trick template.
design.draftText: +1 contract multiplier for each trick in your team's contract when your team wins consecutive tricks

critic.concerns: Differs from ub-consecutive-contract-points only in category, and the long sentence pairs a streak trigger with contract scaling, which is heavy for one line.
